findings.title: No projection: the whole customer document is fetched to read its name
findings.detail: Each lookup returns the full customer document while only the name is used.
findings.fix: Pass a projection that keeps the name only.

findings.title: N+1: a customer query for each order of the page
findings.detail: The loop awaits one findOne per order, so a page of 200 orders costs 200 round trips to the database.
findings.fix: Fetch the customers of the page in one batch and join them in memory.
